Portfolio

Work samples

Three short case studies: one video, one photograph, and one marketing research project. Each covers the context, my role, the tools I used, and the results or the KPIs I would use to measure them.

Video · Short-form social

Full Circle: One-Year Anniversary Reel

Description
A 26-second vertical Reel celebrating one year of Full Circle, a local cafe. It opens on the cafe's sign with an animated "1 year at" title, then moves through the dining room, espresso bar, kitchen crew and guests, and ends on the logo wall. The goal was to show the cafe's people and atmosphere in a format built for Instagram.
My role
Planned the shot sequence, filmed on location, edited the footage to a music track, and added the on-screen title text.
Tools
  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Phone / camera footage
  • Instagram Reels (9:16)
Intended outcomes
KPIs I would track
  • 3-second hold rate and average watch time (completion of the 26 seconds)
  • Shares and saves, as signals the cafe's community connected with it
  • Profile visits and follows after posting
Photography · Brand imagery

Morning Fog, Campus Architecture

Description
An elevated photograph of a sweeping metal-roofed campus building with student housing fading into morning fog. Winding walkways lead the eye into the frame and warm grass in the foreground adds depth. It is a sample of the hero-style imagery I create for campus and brand social content.
My role
Photographer and editor: chose the vantage point and timing, composed the frame, and edited exposure, contrast and color.
Tools
  • Camera
  • Adobe Lightroom
Intended outcomes
KPIs I would track
  • Saves and shares, to see whether the image earns attention beyond followers
  • Reach and profile visits compared with typical posts
  • Consistency: a repeatable look (light, color, framing) across a feed

Marketing project · Research & content

MILLI Matcha: Instagram Audit & Content Strategy

Description
A Group A project for MILLI Matcha, a new matcha cafe in Old Pasadena (@millimatcha). We researched how the cafe's Instagram was performing, used the analytics to inform a Meta Ads approach, and produced videos and images for the cafe's feed.
My role
  • Researched Instagram and Meta Ads analytics to decide which metrics matter for a new cafe
  • Helped audit 30 posts: format, collaborations, engagement rates, and content pillars, with written notes on creative, captions and calls to action
  • Created video and image content to post on MILLI's Instagram
Tools & methods
  • Excel / Google Sheets
  • Engagement-rate formulas
  • Social media audit
  • Content-pillar analysis
  • Meta Ads metrics
Results
  • Creator-collaboration Reels reached far beyond the brand's own audience: the top one drew 66,000 views, about 22 times the best pre-launch Reel (3,004).
  • Likes plus comments per view ranged from about 1.5% to 10.7% across the posts where both were visible.
  • Recommendations from the audit: add "matcha cafe in Old Pasadena" to the bio, pin evergreen menu and visit info in place of the expired giveaway, and add parking and matcha-guide Highlights.
Intended KPIs for Meta Ads
  • Reach and cost per 1,000 impressions (CPM)
  • Link click-through rate and cost per profile visit or follow
  • Engagement rate by reach and follower growth during the campaign
